title: VideoSpec
description: Video Studio spec: one vertical short video (template, theme, voice, scenes, post copy). Omitted theme/voice/music/captions fields fall back to the template defaults.

look.description: Illustrated-kit look; defaults to the template's own look

look3d.description: 3D look (3D templates only); defaults to the template's own look

captionStyle.description: Caption style; captions.style wins when both are set

renderer.description: Render engine: remotion (default) or blender (3D templates only: Eevee frames, slower, cinematic)

stage.description: 3D templates: ONE persistent world shared by every scene (actors, terrain, liquids, world); scenes then declare shots, beats, overlay and focus

concept.description: The world idea of THIS video in a few words

world.description: Static scenery built once (ground, backdrop, props, scatter, crowd)

kind.description: look = the look's own floor (default), none = shadow catcher only, plane | disc | grid | mirror

size.description: plane/grid/mirror: side length; disc: diameter

backdrop.description: Flat backdrop color of the scene (default: the look's gradient)

parts.description: Props, walls, signs and stage dressing built from primitive parts

size.description: Dimensions in world units (<= 8), meaning per shape; torus arc in degrees

facets.description: cylinder, cone, sphere: number of flat sides (4-8 reads as faceted low-poly; omit for a smooth round shape)

text.description: sign: the text printed on the sign (pixel font)

textColor.description: sign: text color (default: readable on the panel)

pos.description: Center in world units (objects stand near the origin; negative z recedes)

pivot.description: Rotation point relative to the part's center (e.g. the shoulder end of an arm)

parent.description: Part id this part hangs from (moves with it)

role.description: Color source when `color` is not set (default body)
